reason
N/A
reason
String
256
For transactions that
require Sandstorm
analysis, records the
Sandstorm status
eligible: The file was identified as eligible for
Sandstorm analysis but was excluded from analys
This may be because Sandstorm was disabled in th
Firewall rule, in a filetype exclusion, in a Web
exception, or because Sandstorm is not licensed
not eligible: The file was not eligible for
Sandstorm analysis because it is not a risky type, o
not a type which can be analysed by the Sandstorm
cloud service
pending: The item required analysis in the cloud;
the end-user was not able to download the item
immediately
cached clean: The item was previously known t
be clean and was allowed
cloud clean: The item was found to be clean aft
analysis in the cloud
Note that for all items sent to the Sandstorm cloud
for analysis, there will be two entries in the "Cont
Filter" logone with reason="pending" when the
is initially requested by the user, and one
with reason="cloud clean" when the file is
known to be OK to download. If the file is found t
be malicious, it will be logged in the antivirus log
with reason="cloud malicious"
